_note: Manually curated iron ore fiscal data. Update annually after reviewing sources below.
_sources: WA Department of Finance – State Budget iron ore royalty receipts
ATO Tax Transparency Report (large companies, annual)
Port Hedland Port Authority – Monthly Throughput Statistics

_units.royaltyRateFOB: fraction of FOB export value — WA state legislated rate for iron ore fines/lump
_units.corporateTaxAUD: AUD millions — sum of BHP + Rio Tinto + FMG Australian iron ore segment tax
_units.costBasisPerMtMin: AUD millions per million tonnes — low-cost Pilbara operations
_units.costBasisPerMtMax: AUD millions per million tonnes — higher-cost operations including port and shipping
